title: Design, Synthesis, and Bioevaluation of Matrine Derivatives as Potential Anti-Hepatitis B Virus Agents.
authors: Liu, Ting-Ting; Xie, Meng-Fan; Liu, Xin; Li, Rong-Tao; Bai, Yao; Zhang, Zhi-Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文为苦参碱衍生物抗乙肝病毒的药物设计与活性评价，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a causative reagent that frequently causes progressive liver diseases, leading to the development of acute hepatitis, chronic hepatitis, cirrhosis, and eventually hepatocellular carcinoma. Despite several antiviral drugs, including interferon-alpha and nucleotide derivatives, being approved for clinical treatment of HBV, critical issues remain unresolved, e.g., their low-to-moderate efficacy and adverse side effects, as well as resistant strains. In this study, twenty-three matrine derivatives were synthesized, and their antiviral effects against HBV were evaluated. Of these, eleven compounds inhibited HBeAg secretion significantly more than the positive control, lamivudine (3TC). Among the compounds synthesized in this study, compounds 4a and 4d had the most potent inhibitory activity, with IC(50) value of 41.78 and 33.68 muM, respectively. Compounds 1h, 4a, and 4d were also subjected to molecular docking studies. These compounds inhibited viral gene expression and viral propagation in a cell culture model. Thus, we believe our compounds could serve as resource for antiviral drug development.
abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）是一种常导致进行性肝脏疾病的致病因子，可引发急性肝炎、慢性肝炎、肝硬化，并最终发展为肝细胞癌。尽管包括干扰素-α和核苷酸衍生物在内的多种抗病毒药物已被批准用于HBV的临床治疗，但关键问题仍未解决，例如其低至中度的疗效、不良副作用以及耐药株的出现。在本研究中，合成了二十三种苦参碱衍生物，并评估了它们对HBV的抗病毒效果。其中，十一种化合物抑制HBeAg分泌的作用显著强于阳性对照拉米夫定（3TC）。在本研究合成的化合物中，化合物4a和4d表现出最强的抑制活性，其IC(50)值分别为41.78和33.68 μM。化合物1h、4a和4d还进行了分子对接研究。这些化合物在细胞培养模型中抑制了病毒基因表达和病毒传播。因此，我们认为我们的化合物可作为抗病毒药物开发的资源。
